# Aura Music — Free High-Fidelity Music Streaming Platform

> Aura Music is an open, high-fidelity music streaming and AI-powered audio discovery web application featuring lossless 320kbps audio playback, real-time synchronized karaoke lyrics, personalized playlists, YouTube Music integration, Google Drive streaming, and 24/7 live internet radios.

## Key Features & Capabilities

- **High-Fidelity Audio Streaming**: Stream millions of tracks at up to 320kbps lossless audio quality with gapless playback, hardware decoding, and DJ crossfade capabilities.
- **Real-Time Synced Karaoke Lyrics**: Millisecond-accurate synchronized lyrics with romanized translations, line-by-line vocal tracking, and dynamic full-screen karaoke mode.
- **Aura AI DJ & Vibe Station**: Generate customized mood playlists using natural language prompts (e.g., "Late night rainy Mumbai acoustic" or "Cyberpunk high-energy workout phonk") powered by generative AI.
- **YouTube & Google Drive Sync**: Seamlessly import, sync, and stream personal YouTube playlists and Google Drive audio collections.
- **24/7 Live Internet Radios**: Curated live non-stop web radios spanning Lofi, Synthwave, Classical, Jazz, Bollywood, and EDM genres.
- **Studio Audio Visualizer & 10-Band Graphic Equalizer**: GPU-accelerated 60FPS audio visualizers, 3D spatial audio simulator, bass boost, and custom equalizer presets.
- **Privacy-First & Ad-Free**: Zero third-party intrusive trackers, respectful of Do-Not-Track headers, and zero banner ads.

## Core Navigation & Pages

- [Homepage](https://aura-music-1no9.onrender.com/): Dynamic daypart greeting, personalized shortcuts, AI vibe station, popular artists rail, and daily trending charts.
- [Discover](https://aura-music-1no9.onrender.com/discover): Explore curated moods, new releases, global top 50, and 24/7 live internet radios.
- [Search](https://aura-music-1no9.onrender.com/search): Fast, predictive search across songs, artists, albums, playlists, and moods with instant suggestions.
- [Library](https://aura-music-1no9.onrender.com/library): Personal collection including liked songs, custom playlists, listening history, local audio files, and Google Drive music.
- [About](https://aura-music-1no9.onrender.com/about): Architecture overview, mission, and open-source credits.
- [Privacy Policy](https://aura-music-1no9.onrender.com/privacy): Transparent data handling and privacy commitments.
- [Terms of Service](https://aura-music-1no9.onrender.com/terms): Usage terms and licensing details.
- [Contact Support](https://aura-music-1no9.onrender.com/contact): Community help, issue reporting, and feedback channels.

## Technical Specifications

- **Frontend**: SvelteKit 5 (Runes), Tailwind CSS 4, Lucide & Hugeicons, Web Audio API, Canvas 2D / WebGL 60FPS engine.
- **Backend Server**: Node.js, Express, JioSaavn 320kbps audio engine, YouTube Music scrapers, FMHY Radio API, LRCLIB Synced Lyrics API.
- **Audio Codecs**: MP3 (320kbps), AAC (256kbps), Opus (160kbps), OGG, FLAC.
